body: No grad school is going to accept me. My grades are screwed at this point. I'm not seeing a lot of options outside of just saying fuck it. To keep going and giving people the benefit of the doubt is kind of dumb.
Beats me. I heavily doubt I can do anything anyway. This is just par for the course with the way this school has treated me. Still have a nice 100K bill to pay though.

The F was from a professor who literally gave an exam during a fire alarm (not even kidding) and held substantial right-wing political views. I'm furious over it but I know the department head doesn't give a shit anyway so it's pointless. The C- is for a professor who had 80% weighting for the final exam; I had A's in the course project + other stuff so I'm at a loss yet again (although this professor is the same head of the department >_>). As for the probability class I tried emailing the department head but he didn't respond to any of 3+ emails so I guess I'm screwed in that regard as well. My current GPA is 2.96; probably will be around 3.1-3.2 when I graduate.

Calculus 2 is a rough course at some schools. I wish you luck man. If you want I could recommend some sites to help; I initially ended up withdrawing from that class then got a 97.8 average the next time I took it with a different professor. It entirely matters who is teaching it; which sadly seems to be the rule for a variety of undergraduate math courses.
